The text observes: *"He seemed so fit, so clear-minded, so full of vitality that we never doubted he would live on for at least a few more years."* Consciousness (*viññāṇa*) is not an independent 'soul' or enduring self; it arises in dependence on contact (*phassa*) and sense objects.
